hero.title: Technology, Process & Institutional Innovation
subtitle: My focus is using technology and AI to improve processes and applications — not just automating, but genuinely making things better.

That mindset comes from my experience across institutional management, QA, and creative production (game design, 3D, front-end).

items.title: QA: Testing this very portfolio
items.objective: Validate usability, content consistency, and correct behavior across key sections.
scope: Responsiveness checks on desktop and mobile
learnings: Organized test cases by section for better traceability.
Prioritized bugs by impact and observed frequency.
Improved checks on navigation and critical content.

items.title: QA: API Testing (Postman collection)
items.objective: Test REST endpoints to validate contracts and expected responses.
learnings: Structured collections and environments for repeatable tests.
Documented payload validations focusing on required fields.
Added negative scenarios for minimum coverage.

items.title: QA: SQL Data Validation
items.objective: Validate a simple database to ensure consistency and basic rules — the same logic applied in production at CONIMS.
learnings: Validation queries applied to real audit scenarios.
Logged data inconsistencies in a clear, traceable way.
Reinforced the value of basic integrity rules.

process.title: How I work
steps: Understand the institutional and technical context, and the people involved.
Break the problem down into clear processes, requirements, or test cases.
Execute with attention to detail — in code, tests, or documents.
Document decisions and results in a way every team can follow.
Continuously review, looking for efficiency and process improvement.

about.title: About
about.summary: Professional with experience in administrative routines, institutional processes, formal documentation, and support for organizing internal workflows, working at the interface between management, technology, and the public sector. I have a multidisciplinary profile, with a background in Game Design and hands-on experience in automation, Google Workspace, data analysis, 3D printing, technical documentation, and process improvement. I'm currently steering my path toward projects that connect innovation, technological infrastructure, institutional relations, and digital solutions applied to the public and private sectors.
highlights: Natural fit between management, technology, and creation
Fast learner across technical and institutional domains
